name: settings
prompt: Production Hangman 2.0 mobile game UI icon. Recreate the small reference at high resolution, preserving its recognizable geometry and optical weight. One isolated flat WHITE glyph with smooth antialiasing, on genuine transparent RGBA background. No button or disc, no baked navy/black outline, no external shadow, no glow, no grey bevel, no extra decoration or lettering. Keep all counters/holes truly transparent. Centre the glyph on a square canvas, preserve the original glyph proportions, with generous clear transparent padding. Output will be normalized to a 256x256 PNG and rendered with the game's existing shadow. Reference is the edit/reconstruction target: a simple eight-tooth white gear with one large transparent circular central hole. Preserve exactly eight chunky evenly spaced teeth, not a flower.

name: back
prompt: Create ONE bold white LEFT CHEVRON navigation icon for Hangman 2.0. Use attached X CLOSE icon as the PRIMARY style reference: same thick flat white strokes, slightly softened squared corners, compact bold geometric character. The second image is the OLD arrow to REPLACE: it is too thin and vertically elongated. New chevron should be noticeably wider and compact: overall visible width about 75 percent of visible height, two equally thick straight diagonals meeting at a clean 90 degree inner turn, about 45-degree diagonals, like the left HALF of the X close glyph, with generous stroke weight (about 23 percent of glyph height). No shaft. No slender tall curved angle. Match X's subtle corner rounding, avoid pill-like terminals. Standalone glyph, transparent background and transparent negative space, pure solid white, no outline, baked shadow, gradients, speckles, texture, button, circle, lettering or decorations. Center on a square canvas; intended final RGBA PNG 256x256 with equal generous transparent padding. One left-pointing chevron ONLY.
